scripts.dev: cd server && bun --watch src/index.ts & cd client && bun run dev
scripts.start: cd client && bun run build && cd ../server && NODE_ENV=production bun src/index.ts
scripts.db:push: cd server && bunx prisma db push
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5188 bun run --cwd client build --outDir dist-e2e && playwright test
